In addition to a full desinstallation and full re-installion and checking before that all "EAanticheat..." files are deleted from all my drive and in addition to what some others have mentioned:
"1. Open your FIFA 23 game location (Let's call it the main folder)
2. Open _Installer > EAAntiCheat > Uninstall and then Install again
3. Back to the main folder and find 3 files: EAAntiCheat.GameServiceLauncher.dll, EAAntiCheat.GameServiceLauncher and Fifa23.exe
4. Open the properties > Digital Signatures > Click on Electronic Arts > Details below the Electronic Arts (not the top of the table) > View Certificate > Install Certificate > (just next until it's done)
5. Do it to the 3 files above-mentioned
6. Check on Steam that Steam is not off-line (Fifa23 will not launch from the shortcut or the source document for from EA app if Steam settings is off-line)
6. Launch your FIFA 23" from the source steam folder 
7. Do not use "admin rights" and verify in the properties of the files mentioned above that admin right is not checked. However for fifa 23.exe I have checked: "desactivated optmisation..."

The biggest fall from grace I have ever seen

Technical Issues
If you buy this game you might not be able to start it like the majority of people as you will see in other reviews. In order to start this game you will firstly need to enter your BIOS, on your high end PC, and change some settings, which if you don't know what you're doing can be extremely risky to the health of your PC. And from then on you will need to uninstall and re install EA's anti cheat on every start up of this game. Once in game you'll find that despite your ultra expensive custom high end PC, the menus are extremely laggy and unresponsive. If you want to tab out of this game, be sure that when you tab in, to move your mouse cursor to the very top right of your screen and out the way, because this game cannot disable the mouse while playing so if the mouse is hovering over a certain menu icon, and you try to navigate with your controller instead, the game will simply bug out. So just from a technical stand point this game is already atrocious.

Gameplay Issues
The game should be advertised as arcade, not the hyper realistic game it markets to be with all these new motion captures, ball physics etc that mislead. The gameplay is arcade, plain and simple. Remember FIFA matches being 5/6 mins a half, by default. Well this time the default is now 3 minutes a half, why? Because any longer, even on the highest difficulty, the score of the match will be 7-7 and you will be fighting against the game just to keep the score down to actually feel a sense of realism. Dribbling is so stupid I can't even put it into words, players are on ice here, no studs in the ground, every player has 1000 agility, because the way they chop and turn and dribble makes no sense, not even Messi can dribble like this in real life, and this is amplified against the AI on any high difficulty, you will not get the ball for at least 2.5 minutes of the 3 minute half because their dribbling is simply uncontrollable.

Career Mode
We all know career mode has been on the decline in forever, which every new feature either breaking the game or being pointless, the dynamic sim feature where you watch dots play like its FM needs so much work, its so bare bones and you will always need to jump in to save your side losing. The new highlight mode is complete garbage with only having a select few highlights, so once you've seen and played a few, you've played them all, and the scenarios get extremely repetitive because of this. Transfers get a transfer rating and whoever rating your business literally has 0 business sense, and you'll likely get sacked for making good business, not to mention you can't loan players out because every loan offer is a loan to buy with a stupid price that can't be negotiated without the deal falling through. All in all another stinker for career mode.

Online
I never got round to playing online as I spent all of my short time in this game troubleshooting and trying to fix the offline game play with various slider settings. But I can imagine the arcade feel of this game translates well to an online simplified experience where you do ridiculous skill moves and score plenty of goals. FUT mode is absolutely packed with features and I would recommend this mode if you have plenty of money you want to spend on getting the best players and items.

Conclusion
I have played FIFA all my life, since FIFA 2004, growing up with the game, buying it every year and without fail playing hundreds of hours. FIFA 17 onwards my hours declined as did the game, but it was still playable up until this release. I can't understand how this game was even able to release in the technical state its in and I genuinely can't believe the huge decline this franchise has gone on over the past half a decade. I'm extremely disappointed. But this game really shows EA for what they are, with extreme amounts of income, can't even spend on the resources to make this game actually playable, its a complete ripoff of all its fans and the kids that spend serious amounts of money on FUT every year, and everyone who has bought this game year in year out faithfully to play career mode.

Utter disaster, don't purchase this game.

First impressions review.

They really need a maybe recommend option cause this is really a not today, but soon kind of recommend. It's breaking ground in terms of being able to both go forward in terms of graphics quality while at the same time going backwards in terms of quantity. What I mean is that it's poorly optimised perhaps, or for whatever reason you can run a smooth 60 fps (top cap though you can choose unlimited) and it will run that perfectly, until it doesn't. Then you are playing a new form of turn based FIFA and your opponent gets 1 free turn and is always ahead of you. 

Now I say better quality because the players out of the gate, and these are the noname FUT bois I get in the starter packs look amazing. It looks like they do simple gfx when you are playing the match, but then load up the high res when you zoom in on the moments, like the celebrations. I'm fine with that. I don't need to see what Son's hair is doing from 200 meters out, but it's a nice touch when you land a stellar goal and the team is going mental! 

Hyper motion is it? It's fine. It's just a slightly better after goal cam occasionally, with some token info that flashes up too fast to process. In time I'll find out what it means but for now it mostly just downgrades the performance. 

Ok, lastly thing I like most about FIFA 23 over Fifa 22? 

The physics seem to have changed and NGL, I absolutely love watching my ST eat Sh*t when he misses his hand off and fully faceplants / flys over the keeper. The ragdoll might have changed or something but I crack up every time, and that's coming off the back of a full year playing Fifia 22. I cannot not recommend highly enough choosing the Womens team as you entry match that the game STILL forces you to play on your first load of the game. You will see dudes running around for the whole next year. Let this be that one glorious time to see you ST go flying into the net, which they now hit if you get the angle right. And that angle can be triangle now. 

The thing I like the least from 22? 

SAME DAMNED ANNOUNCERS!? WTF? Get some new lines. I mostly bought this cause I was hoping to NOT have the exact same BS calls anymore. They were fine but I already heard Derek Rae and Co for over a year. Time to move the fuck on. And it costs so little and adds soo much to the game atmosphere. Huge miss here for me. If you played 22 you heard it all before and it is exactly the same sound file. Zero work was done here on a multi billion dollar game. It's so fuc|<3n weak. 

Do I recommend right now? 

Nah. I recommend you update your drivers and give it a week. Then update them again and learn how to "Clear (your) Directx shader cache"

Also I'll add the play feels slow but that's most likely coming from my All 100 stat man team at the end of 22, into a 80 rated team of noobs. Slow is fine to get a feel for the game, but it mostly feels the same. The controls are mostly the same. Corner kicks have changed, and not sure yet how to feel about that as I usually just play them short. It has potential but it's also the time when the game sh[ts the bed and turns into a 10 fps slog the most often. Corners aren't the only time the slowdowns happen but they are so far the most common for me. As the saying goes, they will fix this in time but for $120 this should be good to go on day one and it's not and it's their laziness of waiting for the problem rather than hunting it down, that caused this. 

TLDR;  GFX up, Performence down, wait a week.

Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man with no history of depression or anxiety. I have never had fits of rage, or been one to break down and cry, but I was in a low spot that just really buried me from being able to see the light on the other side.

Having nothing better to do, I searched for a game I could play, ONE HANDED while I recovered. I somehow stumbled upon this game and read some of the reviews. I decided that it had to be worth a shot... I must admit, I didn't beat the game, or play nearly as long as some of you. In fact, I may have only played this game a day or two.. With that being said, after doing so, I had a new found joy and hope for life. I was able to put behind me the pain and suffering that had been cast over me. I was able to experience other peoples joy and happiness. I was able to see the fruits of my "labor". I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ minutes to this music long enough to realize that I was going to be okay.

I now have 3 kids. My third child is, wait for it, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my own separation, and we just stumbled in to each others life unexpectedly. We have been in a relationship for a year now, and are very happy together.

Moral of the story, you never know what life holds in store for you, and if I would have given up when all the odds were stacked against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

I've always kinda defended FIFA. With the standard phrases like ''It's fun because it's a football game'', or ''You don't understand because you're not a football fan yourself''. But this is different. Way different.

FIFA 23 doesn't even work... It's now a week after release and some folks still aren't able to even launch the game, I have to start Origin in Administrator Mode for it to work, but at least I can play. That being said, servers are trash. They always were, but it's even worse this time. Navigating through the menu's feels buggy and rough around the edges, the game is poorly optimized, and they even haven't fixed some issues that were in FIFA 22, which is astonishing to me.

But now for the most important part, the gameplay. This is where FIFA 23 has it's occasional shine. PC-Players finally got Next-Gen after being completely ignored with FIFA 22 last year. While playing the game, you can feel the game isn't as arcade-like anymore. It's much more slow-paced, and you have to actually think about your next move or pass on the pitch. On the other hand, the AI is mind-blowingly dumb... Players are standing still when the ball rolls past them 15 centimetres away from their feet. Or suddenly your attacker cancels his run past the last defender, which is incredibly frustrating. And maybe the most ridiculous and game-breaking one, if you play against the AI, for example in Career Mode or Squad Battles, the opponent's goalkeeper can't even receive a pass... Like seriously, they are scoring own-goals like it's nothing.

Some new features like the Power Shots are fun and make for some absolute bangers, but the game overall is underwhelming. This combined with the fact that some people that paid 70 or 80 bucks (!!!) can't even start up the game, gave me the feeling I should write a review for this 5/10 game. For now, stay far away from it.

I played FIFA since FIFA 2002 until FIFA 18 with a short break for PES 2009-2011.

FIFA 18 was less fun for me and after trying trial of FIFA 19, I decided I won't buy it. I just moved to other games. When the next FIFA came out, I tried the trial too and decided that I won't waste my time for such a game. Then after a few months, my friend has showed me me coop mode in PES 2020 through Remote Play Together and I loved it, so I bought the game and we had some fun.

When PES 2021 was about to be released we both bought it on release and we spent hundreds of hours in coop mode. There's no such mode in FIFA (and unfortunately in eFootball, but they promised they'll add it at some point).

The coop mode in PES 2021 worked like this - you all join a lobby, one person is a host. The game chooses the best players from active squads of all people in the lobby - if there's 2 people - 9 players from each, if there's 3 people - 6 players from each - a total of 18 players. Then when it finds opponent, the host chooses the squad from the players that game chose and you play together.

eFootball is still better than FIFA, but I try a trial of every new FIFA, hoping that EA finally fixed the game, because they have better modes, but I can't cope with such awfull gameplay mechanics, that aren't fun. Gameplay is more important for me and FIFA feels like a game from generation or two ago in comparison to eFootball.

Fifa has always been fun in general, but this Fifa has a lot of bugs and glitches, especially in FUT;

1. When you're playing FUT Rivals COÖP vs someone who's alone, while you're winning, the opponent can leave the game and FUT gets confused on who to give the 2nd win (since one side plays COÖP), so most of the time my friend doesn't get the win in this case and the win goes to the opponent who was losing. It's ridiculous.
2. There is a game pause glitch, which makes the pause timer and menu disappear so you're basically stuck in the preview screen of the match forever and you're forced to ALT+F4. This way you lose the game too.
3. There is an opponent game leaving glitch, that makes you still keep playing until a half is over. The opponent's team gets the 2nd player (blue triangle) on it and you basically are stuck alone in the game the opponent already gave up on. This gives you the win still, in my case it did at least, but it's so annoying. I captured this glitch on OBS, that's how ridiculous it was.
4. Goalkeepers are glitchy asf. The opponents score goals they really shouldn't, like the keeper and my players run into eachother etc. and the ball awkwardly goes into the goal. Fix this please it's ridiculous.
5. When you have players duplicated, you can't open any packs until you either sell them for 0 coins or are forced to do SBC's, which I hate putting time into. Stop forcing players to do something with items that are not sorted.
6. Huge FPS loss during freekicks, corners kicks, penalties, game replays, goal kicks, etc. basically anything that zooms on the player. FPS goes from stable 80fps to almost 20fps, which makes it harder for players to aim or time.
7. Additional note after review: I was playing COOP Rivals again with a friend, we were winning 4-1, opponent leaves and we both get no win. Minute 70+-.

Besides this, there are sounds or themes missing in the new Fifa's, while they were present in the older Fifa's like Fifa 11 to 15. An example is the crowd audio of Galatasaray, which was accurate before and now it's just random. Can Fifa not put more effort in teams who are outside of the Premier League? England isn't the only country that can play football. You can at least do that for making everyone pay the full game price every single year. It's also funny that there are base game audio's that are not being used in FUT, or being limited on searching things for your stadium or staff in Transfermarkt.

What a sublime end to the Fifa brand of football. 

If you can get over your frustration, your anger and your feeling of resentment towards a company that has no excuses for their bunged releases year on end, then I promise you this, you will end up smiling from ear to ear playing this years version.

I have been playing Fifa games since 1994 and there was a period in there for the last 5 or so years that Fifa just felt like it had been neglected, re-packaged, re-painted and re-gifted to us over and over. I will admit that last years version on console was a pretty great game but this one just feels so right.

For whatever reason I didn't suffer the anticheat issue, I started the game directly out of origin instead of steam and watched it bungle over itself a couple of times saying that the anticheat failed to load or some such rubbish before it just corrected itself and I never looked back.

8 hours in and I honeslty haven't been this motivated to play a fifa game in a decade. The visuals in this version, finally with hypermotion, looks fantastic. The changes to the pitch as you play, the stadiums, and the movement of players is amazing. The detail in the players themselves is incredible. I could never have imagined 28 years ago that a game of football on a computer screen (TV back then) could possibly look or play in such an amazing way. 

Yes we deserve for games to work in the way they are advertised. Yes a game should just load, its kind of fundamental to playing said game. No I have no idea how such a widespread error could make it to launch, particularly from a company as big as this one, and lets hope they understand the value of loyalty by offering some sort of in game compensation. Because we are the same people supporting their product year after year. 

But this is a review about the game you get to play once you overcome the ridiculous roadblocks so many are experiencing. With that in mind, the game is just fantastic. The commentary is the best its been, the sound is wonderful and the speed of the game makes it feel like you are truly playing a game of football. 

I hope so many of you will circle back around after you have played and consider adjusting your reviews to reflect the game, despite the terrible launch. Surely there are a huge team of people that truly poured their passion into delivering such a wonderful game and they must be devastated to have their work be completely overlooked and overshadowed by a poorly implemented anticheat software and a lack of real communication, action and support from their company to us their valued customers.

I hope you all get to experience this game soon and I am sorry for anyone who has been aching to play it, cleared their schedule, only to be faced with an issue that prevents that.
